metrics.name: QA score
metrics.about: Structured Interfaces for Automated Reasoning with 3D Scene Graphs
metrics.evidence: stores the scene graph in Neo4j and lets the LLM query with Cypher: 4k tokens instead of 582k for a serialized scene, with Claude Opus 4.1 scoring 0.94 on QA.

metrics.name: syntactically valid first-shot output
metrics.evidence: A community Qwen2.5-Coder-7B LoRA trained on 1,232 Savage X3D files self-reports about 85 percent syntactically valid first-shot output, methodology undocumented.

metrics.name: verification coverage
metrics.evidence: WorldCoder-Bench (Jun 2026): the best frontier model reaches 27.8 percent verification coverage on 2,026 Three.js world tasks

metrics.name: fine-grained constraints satisfaction rate
metrics.evidence: LEGO-Eval (Nov 2025, v3 Sep 2026): at most 10 percent of generated scenes satisfy fine-grained constraints.
